show.description: On the night of their anniversary, quiet homemaker Raj discovers his wife Simran is cheating on him with her ambitious secretary Rahul and has stolen his fortune, his home, and his identity. But when her betrayal pushes him to the edge, Raj reveals he is the hidden heir to a business empire—and launches a ruthless game of revenge that will destroy every lie she built her life on.
